title: Ning Li last seen at MITRE anti-gravity conference
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ning Li last seen at MITRE anti-gravity conference, about 2003 at Washington, D.C., and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Ning Li's last public talk at MITRE conference

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a scientist named Ning Li, who he says worked on anti-gravity, meaning ways to cancel or weaken the pull of gravity. According to Michels, the last time she spoke publicly and on the record about that work was at a conference about anti-gravity held by MITRE, a research company, near Washington DC around 2003. He tells it because, as he frames it, someone working on gravity-defying technology seems to have stepped out of public view after that.
